QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_20

question.text: Which of the following is the correct ordering of timelines for the Compliance Test Report cycle?

answer.text: IM submits within 30d of FYE -> Sponsor responds within 30d -> IM incorporates within 15d
IM submits within 15d of FYE -> Sponsor responds within 30d -> IM incorporates within 30d
IM submits within 30d of FYE -> Sponsor responds within 15d -> IM incorporates within 15d
IM submits within 60d of FYE -> Sponsor responds within 30d -> IM incorporates within 30d

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI Master Circular (31-July-2023, Annexure 14): (1) IM submits CTR within 30 days of FYE to Sponsor/Trustee, (2) Sponsor/Trustee send observations within 30 days of receipt, (3) IM incorporates changes within 15 days of receipt. Total elapsed time: 75 days from FYE. **The Trap:** The other options perturb individual stages. The key is the 30/30/15 sequence. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C / XIX-D test the same CTR sequence. The 30/30/15 cycle is uniform across AIF categories. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Treat the 30/30/15 CTR cycle as a project-management Gantt — IM drafts from Mar 1; board cut-off Apr 30; Sponsor by May 30; final lock by Jun 15. Any observed compliance violation must then go to SEBI 'at the earliest'.
